name: quote-sys-root
description: QuoteSys 通用商业报价系统工程根目录

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,quote -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:quote"
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['Quote/dist','Quote/release','Workbench/web/dist','Workbench/dist'].forEach(d => fs.existsSync(d) && fs.rmSync(d, {recursive:true,force:true})); console.log('Cleaned build artifacts.');"
